verdict.rationale: Scheduled runs, such as recurring drift detection or apply workflows, are a plausible capability for an infrastructure-as-code tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows OpenTofu offering any built-in scheduling or recurring-job feature. The documented features are on-demand CLI commands (plan, test, import), and running them on a schedule through external cron or CI would be a user-side workaround, which earns no credit.
